text.tspan: Filled marker: confirmatory model in the tested family. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only. Blue ticks: detectable gap after Holm.
Every gap is focal group minus comparison group: a negative gap means the focal group paid less. An empty cell means that test was not run for
